areas.description: Three ghouls lurk here trying to get through the rubble to the hobgoblins in #20. They are not interested in skeletons or zombies as a possible food source.
Six skeletons, three on the east and three on the west, stand like guards stiff at attention and attack intruders on sight.
Zombies wait patiently here under orders to attack and destroy any intruders.
treasure: six intact vials of holy water
features: Splinters of what appears to have been an ornate cabinet

areas.description: The skeletons posted here attack on sight. The outward-facing walls are lined by crypt spaces (3 high, 3 wide per 10' section); many are empty. Those with anything in them have the remains of poor people. Hanging out the gaping square of one crypt space in plain sight is a necklace with gems worth 750 gp; the original owners will be so glad to have it recovered as a sentimental heirloom that they will pay 1,000 gp for it, if they are tracked down.
treasure: original owners will pay 1,000 gp for the recovered necklace if tracked down
features: Outward-facing walls lined by crypt spaces, 3 high and 3 wide per 10' section
Some crypt spaces contain the remains of poor people
